targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::float / current_setting('max_connections')::float AS used FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend';

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Below ~99% on a steady workload usually means shared_buffers / RAM is too small for the hot set (e.g. HNSW/IVFFlat index).

panels.title: Transactions per second
panels.description: A rising rollback share points at application errors or constraint violations.

panels.title: Tuples per second
panels.description: returned >> fetched means many rows are scanned and filtered out (missing index?).

panels.title: Temp files written (bytes/s)
panels.description: Sorts/hashes spilling to disk: raise work_mem or fix the query.

panels.title: Statements per second
panels.description: Needs pg_stat_statements and the exporter flag --collector.stat_statements.

panels.title: DB execution time per second
panels.description: Seconds of query execution per wall-clock second ≈ average busy backends.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: active vs idle vs 'idle in transaction' (the last one holds locks and connections for nothing).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(state, '(background)') AS state, count(*) AS connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT pid, state, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - query_start)::numeric, 1) AS running_s, wait_event_type, left(query, 110) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND datname = current_database() ORDER BY query_start LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Slowest queries (mean execution time)
panels.description: Cumulative since the last pg_stat_statements_reset(). Sort by total_ms instead to find what costs the most overall.

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(s.query, 130) AS query, s.calls, round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS mean_ms, round(s.max_exec_time::numeric, 1) AS max_ms, round(s.total_exec_time::numeric, 0) AS total_ms, s.rows FROM pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid = s.dbid WHERE d.datname = current_database() AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_statements%' ORDER BY s.mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: Largest tables and indexes
panels.description: Includes your pgvector indexes: they usually dominate the footprint.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.relname AS name, CASE c.relkind WHEN 'r' THEN 'table' ELSE 'index' END AS kind, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS bytes FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'i') ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Memory vs limit
panels.description: Only containers with a memory limit (backend in compose.yaml).

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of CPU periods where the container hit its CPU limit and was paused.
